ideas.question: What trends exist in the proportion of SUID cases that occurred within hospital overnight stays between 2004 and 2019?
ideas.why_open: This question explores the changing dynamics of SUID cases occurring within hospital overnight stays, which might reflect broader changes in healthcare practices or newborn care policies over time.
ideas.data: Case series: D82 - Hospital Overnight Stay (ncfrp_v51). Population Reference: D279 - Hospital Stay Length (prams_p8_arf).

ideas.question: How does the proportion of SUID cases among infants with previous medical complications or disabilities change from 2004 to 2019?
ideas.comparison: ncfrp_v51: 2004-2019; prams_p7_arf and prams_p8_arf: Phase 7 (2012-2015) & Phase 8 (2016-2021)
ideas.why_open: This question aims to understand whether the proportion of SUID cases among infants with prior medical complications or disabilities has changed over time, indicating shifts in neonatal health care.
ideas.data: Case series: D246 - Infant Health in Last 72 Hours (ncfrp_v51). Population Reference: D290 - Survey Metadata, including medical conditions before pregnancy.

ideas.question: What is the trend in SUID cases where the infant was exposed to substances or toxins between 2004 and 2019?

ideas.data: Case series: D247 - Infant Meal Details (ncfrp_v51). Population Reference: D296 - Healthcare Visits (prams_p8_arf) including substance exposure.

ideas.question: How has the proportion of SUID cases among infants sleeping on shared surfaces with adults changed from 2004 to 2019?

ideas.question: What trends exist in SUID cases involving infants who have been exposed to domestic violence or abuse between 2004 and 2019?

ideas.why_open: Understanding trends in SUID cases linked to domestic violence or abuse can inform preventive strategies and highlight the importance of family support systems.
ideas.data: Case series: D256 - Child Neglect and Abuse (ncfrp_v51). Population Reference: D290 - Survey Metadata, including emotional or physical abuse.
